panels.title: Requests / min

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where name != "GET /admin/health-check" and name !startswith "GET /public/"
| summarize v = count() / (($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) / 1m)

panels.title: Request rate by operation (top 8)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let base = materialize(requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where name != "GET /admin/health-check" and name !startswith "GET /public/"
| extend op = replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_regex(name, @"[A-Z]+\.GB\.\d{4}\.\d+[A-Z]?", "{ref}"), @"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27}", "{guid}"), @"/\d+(/|$)", @"/{n}\1")
);
let top = base | summarize total = count() by op | top 8 by total | project op;
base
| where op in (top)
| summarize n = count() by op, bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.description: Calls per bin for the eight busiest operations.

panels.title: Errors: 4xx and 5xx

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where name != "GET /admin/health-check" and name !startswith "GET /public/"
| extend cls = case(toint(resultCode) >= 500, "5xx", toint(resultCode) >= 400, "4xx", "")
| where cls != ""
| summarize n = count() by cls, bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.description: 4xx is usually the caller's fault (validation, auth); 5xx is ours.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where name != "GET /admin/health-check" and name !startswith "GET /public/"
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where name != "GET /admin/health-check" and name !startswith "GET /public/"
| extend op = replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_regex(name, @"[A-Z]+\.GB\.\d{4}\.\d+[A-Z]?", "{ref}"), @"[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F-]{27}", "{guid}"), @"/\d+(/|$)", @"/{n}\1")
| summarize Calls = count(), ['4xx %'] = round(100.0 * countif(toint(resultCode) between (400 .. 499)) / count(), 2),
    ['5xx %'] = round(100.0 * countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) / count(), 2),
    ['p50 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 50)), ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by Operation = op
| order by Calls desc
| take 50

panels.title: Outbound calls by target

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where type != "InProc"
| extend dep = strcat(type, " · ", target)
| summarize Calls = count(), ['Fail %'] = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 2),
    ['p95 ms'] = round(percentile(duration, 95)), ['Max ms'] = round(max(duration)) by Type = type, Target = target
| order by Calls desc

panels.description: Everything this service calls: other microservices, SQL, Service Bus, blob storage, Entra ID.

dependencies

panels.title: Slowest dependency calls

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where type != "InProc"
| extend dep = strcat(type, " · ", target)
| top 20 by duration desc
| project Time = timestamp, Target = dep, Call = name, ['Duration ms'] = round(duration), OK = success, Result = resultCode, ['Operation id'] = operation_Id

panels.title: Custom metrics (trackMetric, @Timed)

azureLogAnalytics.query:
customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| where name !startswith "jvm_" and name !startswith "http" and name !startswith "spring_" and name !startswith "tomcat_"
    and name !startswith "process_" and name !startswith "system_" and name !startswith "disk_" and name !startswith "logback_"
    and name !startswith "tasks_" and name !startswith "application_" and name !startswith "executor"
    and name !startswith "hikaricp_" and name !startswith "jdbc_" and name != "HeartbeatState"
    and name !in ("Total Started Thread Count", "Peak Thread Count", "Heap Memory Usage", "Non Heap Memory Usage", "Thread Count",
      "GC Total Time", "GC Total Count", "% Of Max Heap Memory Used", "Heap Memory Used (MB)", "Suspected Deadlocked Threads", "Loaded Class Count")
| summarize Samples = sum(valueCount), Avg = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 1), Max = round(max(valueMax), 1) by Metric = name
| order by Samples desc

defaults.noValue: This service sends no custom metrics

panels.description: Metrics the service code records itself. Most are durations in ms. JVM, HTTP and Spring metrics are left out.

panels.title: Top exceptions

azureLogAnalytics.query:
exceptions
| where timestamp between (($__timeFrom() - 7d) .. $__timeTo())
| where cloud_RoleName in ("$service", "$namespace.$service")
| where tostring(customDimensions["k8s.namespace.name"]) == "$namespace"
| summarize Count = countif(timestamp >= $__timeFrom()), Before = countif(timestamp < $__timeFrom()),
    ['Last seen'] = max(timestamp), Message = take_any(outerMessage) by Type = type, ['Problem id'] = problemId
| where Count > 0
| extend New = iff(Before == 0, "new", "")
| project New, Count, Type, Message, ['Last seen'], ['Problem id']
| order by Count desc
| take 25

panels.description: 'new' means the problem id did not occur in the 7 days before the selected range: a likely regression.
